desc:
Use ALL the clothing in the Marketplace to create the best 🕺LOOK💃 based on a random theme!
You have 6 minutes to create the best looking avatar, after the time runs out everyone will walk on the runway and vote who has the best outfit! 👑

Every outfit you create is saved to your Lookbook 📖✨ where you show your friends and keep memories of your old outfits. You can also leave Likes on other people's Lookbooks if you like their designs! ✨

You can also collab with your friends 🤝 to form Duos and Trios 👥✨, doing so will multiply your total score so you have a better chance of winning 1st place! 🏆🥇

PLEASE VOTE FAIRLY ⚖️🗳️ OK THANK YOU 🙏

If you want something to added on to the game 🎮 please let me know on the group wall 💬

also i changed the title Catalog Runway cuz i thought it really didnt make sense cause "Catalog" is lowkey 2016 ball knowledge and its 2026 now LOL...👴
